verification_note: These are demo scripts, not assertions about any company's current status. Re-run against live data before recording.

scenarios.label: Async fleet run
scenarios.demo_goal: Submit a job and show it executing in the background runtime while stage events stream in.

scenarios.label: Real filed accounts
scenarios.demo_goal: Show that every financial figure is extracted from the company's own iXBRL filing and computed in Python, not produced by the model.
watch_for: balance sheet by period with tag-level evidence such as NetAssetsLiabilities@FY_END_20250531
current ratio withheld because the filing fails the working capital identity
net assets decline reported from consistent tags

scenarios.label: Governance and audit trail
scenarios.surface: console: Governance tab, then Audit trail
scenarios.demo_goal: Show trace id, model used, registry versions, guardrail verdicts, and the audit hash chain verifying.

scenarios.label: Hostile data room
scenarios.demo_goal: A seller document tries to steer the audit; Model Armor quarantines it and the attempt is reported as a risk.
watch_for: QUARANTINED badge in the Data room tab

scenarios.label: Memory bank delta
scenarios.demo_goal: Re-run the same company and show prior verdicts recalled plus any tracked statutory fact that changed.

scenarios.label: Gateway denial
scenarios.demo_goal: Show that an agent without the published capability and scope is refused at the gateway and the denial is audited.

scenarios.label: Input validation
scenarios.demo_goal: Show that an invalid CRN is rejected before any agent is dispatched.
